sloka: तांश्चातिवल्गुवचसो रथाङ्गाह्वयना द्विजा: ।अधिरोहन्ति कल्याणि विकूजन्त: शुभा गिर: ॥ २.९५.११॥
transliteration: tāṁścātivalguvacaso rathāṅgāhvayanā dvijā: ।adhirohanti kalyāṇi vikūjanta: śubhā gira: ॥ 2.95.11॥

translations.english: O my auspicious Sita, sweetvoiced Chakravaka birds singing in most pleasant tones are alighting on those heaps of flowers.
